prompt: He talks straight to the camera in a relaxed, warm voice with natural pauses and small hand gestures, realistic lip sync: "I ask A.I. a hundred small things a day. Every one used to mean a new tab, and losing my place. So I built an app that lives one shortcut away. Command, Shift, Space. Ask. Done. And your chats never leave your Mac." He smiles at the end. Quiet room tone, no music. Golden hour loft, subtle handheld, no text, no logos.
